verdict.rationale: Railway documents that you can scale CPU and RAM or add replicas behind a load balancer. Nothing in the evidence says it adds or removes capacity automatically based on load, so this is an adjacent manual-scaling control, not load-based autoscaling for traffic bursts. The outage-related community posts are not about autoscaling and were ignored.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can rely on load-based autoscaling to absorb large traffic bursts automatically

citations.quote: Scale CPU and RAM or add replicas with load balancing.
